hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -e # Exit on any error
# Pull the latest code from the repository git pull origin root || exit 1
# Build Docker images for all services docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml build || exit 1
# Run unit tests docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml run --rm api pytest --maxfail=1 --disable-warnings -q || exit 1
# Apply Kubernetes configurations kubectl apply -f kubernetes/persistent-volumes.yaml || exit 1 kubectl apply -f kubernetes/deployment.yaml || exit 1 kubectl apply -f kubernetes/service.yaml || exit 1
# Wait for deployments to be ready kubectl rollout status deployment/symbolic-reasoning-deployment kubectl rollout status deployment/federated-learning-deployment kubectl rollout status deployment/api-deployment kubectl rollout status deployment/frontend-deployment
# Verify all pods are running if ! kubectl get pods | grep -v "Running"; then echo "All pods are running successfully" else echo "Some pods are not running" >&2 exit 1 fi
